name: TDHitscanAttack
src_typeComment: Instant-hit tower attack: deals damage immediately, no travel time. Optionally draws a brief beam via a LineRenderer for visual feedback — leave it unassigned for a silent hit.

src_serialized.name: beam
src_serialized.tooltip: Optional — if assigned, briefly draws a beam from this tower to the target on each shot.

src_serialized.name: beamDuration
src_serialized.tooltip: How long the beam stays visible, in seconds.

src_serialized.name: muzzle
src_serialized.tooltip: World-space point the beam originates from (e.g. a turret barrel tip). Defaults to this transform if left empty.

src_members.sig: public void Attack(TDEnemy target, float damage)
src_members.name: Attack
